subject: MAP & Evaluation Plan Kickoff — ZenWell POC
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@zenwell.com>, Marcus Liang <marcus.liang@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & Evaluation Plan Kickoff — ZenWell POC

Hi Aisha / Marcus —

Congrats again on getting the POC greenlit. To keep things moving and make the evaluation deterministic, I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and an initial prompt set we suggest using for the benchmark. Proposed high-level success criteria: 

- Accuracy / relevance: >= 90% pass rate on ZenWell rubric (prompt-level binary pass)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 220ms for single-request inference on our Dedicated tier
- Cost: average per-request token cost below the threshold we discussed (we'll surface numbers after baseline run)
- Robustness: no more than 2% hallucination rate on a 300-sample test set

We propose the following timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize owners + access to test data and eval harness
- Week 1: baseline runs + quick qualitative review
- Week 2: prompt tuning + quantization/ops tweaks, rerun benchmarks
- Week 3: final evaluation + decision meeting (target close: 2026-03-12)

Action items we need from ZenWell today:
1) Confirm primary POC owner for product decisions and one technical owner for integration.
2) Share the set of representative patient-facing prompts or a subset we can use as a seed (we've attached eval_prompt_set_v1.csv; feel free to overwrite).
3) Approve the success criteria above or indicate changes.

Attachments: zenwell_map_template.xlsx (MAP template), eval_prompt_set_v1.csv (starter prompts).

I'll schedule a 45-minute kickoff for next week once we have owners. Let me know any calendar constraints.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM serving
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@zenwell.com>

Cc: Marcus Liang <marcus.liang@zenwell.com>, ZenWell Evaluation Team <eval-team@zenwell.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan Kickoff — ZenWell POC

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good and thanks for the clear template. Quick answers from our side: 

- POC product owner: Aisha Patel (me) — overall acceptance criteria and clinical escalation decisions.
- Technical/integration owner: Marcus Liang (CC'd) — will own data access, API integration, and infra during the POC.
- Evaluation contact: ZenWell Evaluation Team (eval-team@zenwell.com) — will own rubric scores and QA.

We like the proposed success criteria but would like to tweak the accuracy threshold to >= 88% (due to some edge-case prompts) and add a user-satisfaction proxy: target NPS-like survey score >= 4.0 on a small qualitative cohort. We can confirm public-patient-data constraints in the kickoff (some prompts have PHI redaction requirements).

Can you confirm Redwood's expected data handling for the seed prompt set and whether we should redacted versions in advance? Also, Marcus will need a service account/API key and a short runbook for the baseline.

Available for a kickoff next Wed or Thu afternoon (PST).

Best,
Aisha
Director of Product, ZenWell Health
aisha.patel@zenwell.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
